description: Get a workflow run with step-level details. Poll this after run_workflow until status is terminal (completed, failed or cancelled).

run_id.description: Workflow run UUID, the run_id returned by run_workflow or a run id from get_workflow `recent_runs`.

name: get_workflow_run

status.description: pending, running, completed, failed or cancelled; the last three are terminal.

steps.description: One entry per step the run has reached, in order.

id.description: Run step UUID (not the workflow step id).

output.description: The step's result, e.g. a checklist run summary.

status.description: pending, running, completed, failed or skipped.

title: Get workflow run
